description: Look for new coverage of one of the user's approved listings with the same accuracy rules and moderation as the dashboard's "Refresh news" (once a minute per listing). Requires the user's confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

listing.description: One of the user's own approved listings.

name: refresh_listing_news
title: Refresh my listing's news
